description: Track local visibility for a domain across keywords and locations. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

domain.description: Website hostname to track across the supplied keywords and markets, for example example.com. Type: String. Required.

keywords.description: Search phrases to evaluate or associate with the supplied page. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 5 items. Required.

items.description: One search keyword or phrase, not a comma-separated list. Type: String. Required.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

locations.description: Supported geographic market names to check, for example Austin, Texas, United States; each keyword/location combination contributes work. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 3 items. Required.

items.description: One supported geographic market name, for example Austin, Texas, United States. Type: String. Required.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

name: agentseo_local_visibility_track
title: AgentSEO Local Visibility Track
